pins.name: 5V
pins.notes: Pin order varies between boards: match by the printed label. Use VIN for a few LEDs; a separate 5 V supply for more (up to 60 mA per LED)

pins.name: CI
pins.notes: Clock in. Works with SPI; a 3.3 V to 5 V level shifter makes it reliable

pins.name: DI
pins.notes: Data in. Has no chip select: give the strip its own SPI bus

sources.title: APA102 (Shiji Lighting) datasheet
sources.section: Two-wire clock and data input; supply 5 V
